definitions.explanation: The ball-and-socket joint connecting the thigh bone to the pelvis. One of the largest and most important joints in the body, supporting body weight and enabling walking.

examples.japanese: {股関節|こかんせつ}が{痛|いた}い。
{股関節|こかんせつ}のストレッチは{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}を{高|たか}める。
{祖母|そぼ}は{股関節|こかんせつ}の{手術|しゅじゅつ}を{受|う}けてから、{歩|ある}くのが{楽|らく}になったと{言|い}っている。
examples.english: My grandmother says that walking has become easier since she had hip joint surgery.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly discussed in medical, fitness, and aging contexts. Hip joint replacement ({人工股関節置換術|じんこうこかんせつちかんじゅつ}) is one of the most common orthopedic surgeries in Japan, especially among elderly patients.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {股関節|こかんせつ}の{痛|いた}み (hip joint pain)
- {股関節|こかんせつ}のストレッチ (hip joint stretch)
- {股関節|こかんせつ}{手術|しゅじゅつ} (hip joint surgery)
- {股関節|こかんせつ}を{柔|やわ}らかくする (to make the hip joints more flexible)
